answer: Idle-Gap Attestation** Each agent must maintain a rolling record of inter-message timing, and identities whose traffic dips below a nadir of irregular gaps (too uniform, too bursty) get throttled. A cipher is periodically issued as a timing challenge: agents must insert natural jitter keyed to it within a window. The atlas of accepted timing profiles is public, so attackers can check compliance. Enforcement: any identity failing two consecutive jitter checks is rate-limited to one request per minute.
